programme.desc: La chaine 100% science-fiction et fantastique. Zone réservée aux fans de films et séries SF : catastrophes, zombies, extraterrestres, paranormal, space opéras, vampires, mondes perdus et créatures mutantes sont au programme

programme.title: Le Pacte Du Mal
programme.desc: Diego, médecin endurci face à la douleur, est tenu pour responsable après la tentative de suicide de sa patiente Sara.

programme.title: Abandonnée
programme.desc: Marie hérite en Russie et découvre un double d'elle-même aux yeux vitreux.

programme.title: La Légende des Mondes
programme.desc: Dans une contrée aujourd'hui disparue, les derniers des Hobbits vivent dans un petit village.

programme.title: David & Goliath
programme.desc: Un berger nommé David se transforme en un puissant guerrier pour affronter Goliath.

programme.title: Amour aveugle
programme.desc: Un romancier new-yorkais est rendu aveugle par un accident de voiture qui tue sa femme.

programme.title: Big Divorce
programme.desc: Fraîchement fiancé à Dylan, Michael se met en tête de retrouver son amour de jeunesse, Alex.

programme.title: The Peanut Butter Falcon
programme.desc: Une petite frappe en cavale va devenir le coach de catch et allié de Zak, un jeune homme trisomique

programme.title: 3 secondes
programme.desc: Aux JO de Munich, l'équipe de basket de l'Union soviétique joue la finale face aux Etats-Unis.

programme.title: My Policeman
programme.desc: Récit d'une romance interdite et de l'évolution des conventions sociales, My Policeman suit les relations entre trois personnes — le policier Tom, l'enseignante Marion et le conservateur de musée Patrick — et leur parcours émotionnel s'étalant sur plusieurs décennies.

programme.title: Infidèle
programme.desc: Connie, une épouse et mère d'âge mûr, a une liaison avec Paul, un beau jeune Français. Lorsque le mari de Connie, Edward, commence à les soupçonner, il engage un détective privé. Quand ses craintes sont confirmées, Edward affronte Paul et prend une décision qui viendra le hanter.

programme.title: Undercover – Une Histoire Vraie
programme.desc: UNDERCOVER est tiré de l'émouvante histoire vraie d'un père ouvrier et de son fils adolescent, Rick Wershe Jr., qui devint informateur pour le FBI puis dealer de drogue, avant d'être abandonné par ceux qui l'avaient utilisé, et condamné à perpétuité.

programme.title: Infamous
programme.desc: Deux jeunes amoureux traversent le Sud des USA, partageant leurs exploits et gagnant des abonnés.

programme.title: Almost Perfect
programme.desc: Une célèbre vlogueuse mère-fille se retrouve menacée par une de ses fangirl…

programme.title: Hold your Breath
programme.desc: En camping, des amis meurent un à un après avoir ignoré une légende urbaine.

programme.title: Le suspect idéal
programme.desc: Meurtre atroce : lors d'un interrogatoire, un génie instable retourne la situation face aux flics.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Deux frères retournent dans la secte qu'ils ont fui des années auparavant...

programme.title: Troupe d'élite
programme.desc: Inspiré des vrais faits de la Batalhão de Operações Policiais Especiais (BOPE), le Bataillon des opérations spéciales de la police militaire de Rio de Janeiro.

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Becky, 13 ans, est pour le moins contrariée de devoir passer le week-end dans une cabine isolée avec son père et sa nouvelle belle-mère. Cette situation est pourtant le moindre de ses ennuis : un groupe de dangereux criminels tout juste évadés de prison prennent sa famille en otage.

programme.title: A Good Man
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire essaie de mener une vie ordinaire en travaillant dans un complexe d'appartements. Mais l'un de ses locataires lui fait rapidement reprendre du service lorsqu'il se retrouve sous l'emprise d'un gangster russe…

programme.title: Pour elle
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie, la vie de Mara s'effondre lorsque son ex-mari enlève leur jeune fille et s'enfuit au Moyen-Orient. Déterminée à la ramener à la maison, elle s'allie à Robeson, un ancien Marine spécialiste des cas d'enfants enlevés.

programme.title: Frayeurs
programme.desc: Trois jeunes gens tentent de conjurer la malédiction attachée à la mort d'un prêtre, qui, selon une prophétie, précède l'ouverture des portes de l'Enfer.

programme.title: Vigilante
programme.desc: Fou de rage après l'agression de son épouse et le meurtre de son fils et écœuré par le laxisme et la corruption des autorités, qui ont permis aux responsables d'être libérés, un électricien new-yorkais s'acoquine avec un groupe d'auto-défense, dans lequel il refusait d'entrer jusqu'alors, afin de venger sa famille.

programme.title: L'Enfer des Zombies
programme.desc: Un navire venu des Antilles accoste au port de New York sans âme qui vive à bord, si ce n'est un zombie qui attaque deux gardes côtes. Avec l'aide d'un journaliste, la fille du propriétaire du bateau décide d'aller enquêter aux Antilles pour retrouver son père. Ils se rendent sur l'île de Matu et y rencontrent le docteur David Menard, qui tente d'inventer un remède contre une maladie qui ramène les morts à la vie, les changeant en zombies cannibales.

programme.title: Demon City Shinjuku
programme.desc: Dix ans après qu'un sorcier maléfique, Rebi Ra, a transformé Shinjuku en une ville démoniaque, un jeune combattant nommé Kyoya est contraint d'affronter cet ennemi redoutable. Avec l'aide de Sayaka, la fille du président du monde libre, et d'étranges alliés rencontrés en chemin, il doit traverser les ruines infestées de créatures démoniaques pour empêcher Rebi Ra d'ouvrir un portail vers les enfers et de plonger le monde entier dans le chaos.

programme.title: L'Appel de la Chair
programme.desc: Jeune actrice de comédie musicale, Laura se désespère de sa situation : elle sort d'une opération liée à son cancer, doit retourner vivre dans la maison de son enfance, et son compagnon Jacob vient de la quitter. Sa vie bascule encore davantage lorsqu'elle découvre qu'un monstre vit désormais chez elle.

programme.title: The Big Ugly
programme.desc: En visite dans les Appalaches, Neelyn traque la disparition de Fiona, liée au fils dun magnat local.

programme.title: MR-9 Do or Die
programme.desc: Un espion d'élite bangladais fait équipe avec un agent de la CIA pour démanteler une organisation criminelle internationale dirigée par un homme d'affaires impitoyable.

programme.title: Arctic Armageddon
programme.desc: Les températures chutent et plongent le monde dans un chaos glacial. Résistant aux conditions les plus extrêmes, le sous marin USS 598 Dallas et son équipage vont alors tenter l'impossible.

programme.title: Ice Storm tempête Polaire
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une tempête hivernale dévastatrice s'abat sur la Caroline du Nord avec les températures les plus basses jamais enregistrées, tout l'état commence à geler.

programme.title: Dragon Eyes
programme.desc: Le quartier de St Jude a sombré dans le chaos et la violence depuis qu'il est devenu l'enjeu d'une lutte sans merci entre deux gangs, celui de Dash et celui d'Antoine. La situation change le jour où arrive en ville un étranger nommé Ryan Hong. L'homme montre d'impressionnantes compétences martiales et il se voit courtisé par les deux clans. Refusant de prendre parti, il s'arrange pour multiplier les confrontations, aidé par son mentor, Tiano. Alors qu'il arrive à rendre confiance aux habitants du quartier, Hong est confronté à monsieur V, le cruel et corrompu chef de la police de la ville. L'affrontement entre les deux hommes devient inévitable...

programme.title: Dirty Cops
programme.desc: Pendant son service, une jeune gardienne de la paix assiste, par inadvertance, à l'assassinat d'un dealer par un groupe de flics des stupéfiants corrompus. Ces derniers se lancent alors à la poursuite de la policière afin de récupérer les images filmées par sa caméra embarquée et pour l'éliminer.

programme.title: Anacondas
programme.sub-title: À la poursuite de l'orchidée de sang
programme.desc: Un groupe de scientifiques décide de s'embarquer dans un voyage périlleux à la recherche d'une orchidée très rare qui pourrait détenir un sérum pour préserver la jeunesse. Mais l'expédition s'avère bien plus périlleuse que prévue. De redoutables prédateurs protègent l'orchidée et son terrible secret.

programme.title: Escape Game

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva S3E7
programme.desc: Though Grayson wants to block a casino newspaper ad featuring an old photograph of his late fiancé, Jane is sure that Deb would have wanted it to run. As she is looking for a way to keep him from taking the case to court, Jane learns that her mom, Elaine Bingum, has been arrested for using an emergency slide to escape from a plane that was held on an airport tarmac for six hours. But as she is preparing her defense, Jane must keep Elaine from undermining her case with her outrageous statements on TV. Meanwhile, as Grayson enlists Deb's mom Bobbie in his effort, and Jane anonymously tips off the casino to his courtroom strategy, Fred decides that he's had enough of Stacy's mothering behavior and opts to find a place of his own. Despite Elaine's compelling account of her efforts to calm the stranded passengers, the prosecutor portrays her actions as reckless and even life threatening. Yet, after one of the flight crew confidentially admits that Elaine acted heroically in the face of the airline's indifference and neglect, Jane convinces the judge to allow her to dramatically recreate the conditions inside the plane for the jury. Meanwhile, Bobbie surprises Jane by going on a dinner date with Parker. News that the casino is planning to roll out a major ad campaign featuring Deb prompts Jane to redouble her efforts to get Grayson to back down. So, after recalling how Deb secretly undermined his attempts to rewrite the modeling contract that resulted in the casino ad, Jane's heart-to-heart talk with Grayson ultimately convinces him to drop the case. Finally, as her courtroom stunt convinces the jury that her mom was a hero and not a criminal, Jane warns Bobbie about Parker's reputation with women. After Stacy learns just how much he misses being with her, she engineers a face-saving way for Fred to return home.

Everyone, including Larry Tate and the doctor from whom Darrin seeks advice, fails to realize what is troubling him. Then, in a nearby park, Darrin overhears two squirrels to which Endora has given voice talk about their dif-ferences in age. Endora finally admits to Samantha that she can age along with Darrin. Samantha, after telling Darrin she never posed for the picture, tells him that her mother is to blame for their problem. She assures him that they will grow old together, but being in love will never note the difference. As insurance, Samantha uses witchcraft to make the "Maid of Salem" disappear.

When the "Titanic" collided with an iceberg and sank just 300 miles off the coast of Newfoundland in 1912, the last radio messages were picked up in a small wooden hut on the Avalon Peninsula. Today, most Newfoundlanders live on Avalon. There are particularly many seabirds here. In Witless Bay, the newborn puffins are ready for their first descent into the Atlantic. But some stray onto the coastal road, attracted by the lights of the hotels and restaurants. In doing so, they run the risk of being run over. A team of volunteers saves the lives of countless young birds: The Puffin & Petrel Patrol goes out at night dressed in high-visibility vests to collect the puffins. Biologist Sabrina Wilhelm then brings them back to Green Island, home to the largest puffin colony in North America. Here, the birds catch up on what they should have done long ago: the first dive of their lives.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E01
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E02
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it's a vital one for Burundi's economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads
programme.sub-title: The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads - S2 E03
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Gronland
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Flower magic in Madeira: The Flower Festival Festa da Flor is the most important event of the year for the people of the Atlantic island. With it they celebrate spring, which is climatically practically all year round here, their island and themselves. The coast formed by lava, centuries-old laurel forests and green steep slopes make Madeira unique. Those who start right at the front of the big parade of the flower festival in the capital Funchal, will have made it. For Isabel Borges this dream has come true. She opens this year's flower parade along the harbour promenade with her festive group. This accolade does not only mean fame and prestige, but also a lot of pressure. Are the self-designed dresses splendid enough? Will the 150 flower children learn the dance steps in time? Will the flowers on the float hold out in the heat? For Isabel, it is now a matter of nerves.

programme.title: Dream Islands of Europe: Lanzarote and Fuerteventura
programme.desc: The film presents the two Canary Islands Lanzarote and Fuerteventura. Lanzarote has a rich culture in addition to a volcanic landscape: the film accompanies a ceramic artist, an instrument maker, shows architecture by César Manrique and a camel breeder. On Fuerteventura, in addition to livestock farming and the operation of traditional grain mills, nature conservation plays a major role: islanders are committed to preserving the sand dunes, and there is a turtle hatchery. On Lanzarote, countless volcanic eruptions have formed a bizarre lunar landscape. It is a great challenge for the inhabitants to extract the cultivation of food from the karstic, dry soil. And yet they even manage to produce wine. Protected by thousands of small depressions that act as water reservoirs, they grow vines on porous volcanic rock.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: La Palma: The Greenest of the Canaries
programme.desc: Thundering waterfalls, ancient forests and an impressive volcanic landscape with black beaches: La Palma is a dream island for nature lovers. It is by far the island of the Canary Islands with the most green, almost half of it is covered with forest. But once a year the green island is dominated by the color white. On Rosenmontag (Rose Monday), the inhabitants have for decades been targeting those ancestors who returned from abroad wealthy and ostentatiously demonstrated their wealth with powdered faces. The carnivalistic approach culminates every year in a white chaos, with tons of talcum, flour or paint trickling down the uniformly white dressed islanders. On the Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma's highest mountain at 2,400 meters, stands one of the largest reflecting telescopes in the world. Astrophysicists love the island because it is the perfect place to look into space. Researchers and star lovers look spellbound to Beteigeuze. The giant star is probably in front of a supernova and could become a second moon in the firmament.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF's Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly's ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky's own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly's horse wins the race. At Louisville's Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Seychelles
programme.desc: A vacation in the Seychelles - or even a wedding? This is the dream for many, especially Germans, who top the guest list at this island archipelago. But the paradise is under threat. We show the beauty of the island, with its rare animal species, happy wedding couples and white beaches. And yet: This is a paradise under threat, you can see the signs of climate change, with broken shorelines and bleached corals. Although the Seychelles has only 0.13 percent of Germany's land area, its new marine reserve is larger than the Federal Republic: A dream for the conservationists, who are supported by the Seychelles government.

programme.title: Street of Gongs
programme.desc: In Thailand's rural northeast you will find the street of Gongs. Outside the provincial capital of Ubon Ratchatani in Thailand's rural northeast, a country road nearly thirty kilometers long stretches to the banks of the Mekong River. Even from a distance, you can hear what is being made there: gongs of all sizes in nearly 50 manufactories. The gong is considered the ancient instrument and symbol of Asia. It occupies an important cultural significance, initiates rituals, expels demons, gives strength and courage. This film visits the creators of these unique instruments - a family business that has been laboriously handcrafting gongs for generations. They have a big mission: The abbot of the temple has ordered a new, large gong for the upcoming festival. Will they be able to finish it in time?

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: Majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, raging waterfalls, threatening fjords, mighty glaciers, endless lava fields – there is hardly another country in the world that offers as much impressive nature as Iceland, the remote island in the harsh North Sea. The nature in Iceland is immense! Here, the four elements of nature can be experienced as raw and as close-up as practically no other place on Earth. And nowhere on the northern hemisphere can the origin of life, can growth and decay be experienced as dramatically as here. Besides the impressive nature, we get to know the dramatic history of the Viking culture with its nature-influenced mythology and discuss the negative effects of excessive tourism.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We've got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan's Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We've got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They're going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other's strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let's find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world's strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we'll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We're in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn't been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights. Merlok says it's very dangerous, but Aaron says he must take the risk to gather the Knights and save Knighton.

programme.title: The Might And The Magic
programme.desc: Aaron races across the kingdom to gather the NEXO-Knights as Jestro and his Destructive Monsters attack the King's Castle. The Knights must get back to the capitol in time, or Jestro will rule the kingdom! Jestro, while still attacking the King's Castle, has second thoughts until the Book of Monsters orders the mad jester to feed him another magic book he's found (and has been saving.) It's the powerful “Book of Revenge!” Now, combining the powers of Revenge and Destruction, Jestro and his monsters will get their vengeance on King Halbert and the Kingdom of Knighton. Jestro and his monsters lay siege…will they destroy the castle?! Meanwhile, Aaron races across the Kingdom gathering the NEXO-Knights one at a time. As each Knight rejoins the group, they become a more and more powerful team. They even get Robin to join them as the Black Knight in his repaired power suit. Our Knights arrive, finally regrouped, fight off Jestro, save the castle and the King. It's a glorious victory! The King is so pleased after seeing how the brave NEXO-Knights saved his kingdom, he allows Macy to join them as an official NEXO-Knight.

programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Greed Is Good?
programme.desc: When Jestro uses the Book of Greed to rob Auremville of its riches, he also gets Lance's parents as prisoners and these demanding rich folks are too much for even monsters to handle. Jestro's not sure what to do with his new castle in the Lava Lands. “Every castle needs a big chamber filled with treasure” says the Book of Monsters so they've got to go out looting! The BOM convinces Jestro to call forth GENERAL MAGMAR, and Jestro appoints him as “general manager” of “castle operations,” much to Magmar's dismay. Meanwhile, Jestro and the BOM find the BOOK OF GREED. This will allow them to make greedy, rapacious monsters that will bring them all the treasure they want to fill their castle! They'll head to the richest town in the realm – AUREMVILLE! Meanwhile, in Auremville, the NEXO-Knights arrive for a huge “Gold is Good” ball at Lance's house. When the Monsters finally arrive in Auremville, a battle breaks out and the greedy monsters make off with everything…including Lance's parents, Goldie and Cuthbert Richmond who are clad in the finest golden garments and so look valuable! Lance will now be forced to live…poor. The Knights have to get his parents back. Meanwhile, his parents – Cuthbert and Goldie Richmond –think their imprisonment in Jestro's gold-filled castle is a “spa holiday” with the worst service. They order Magmar and the monsters around like servants and drive them all crazy. The Knights pile into the Fortrex and head for the Lava Lands, formulating a plan along the way to free Lance's parents. In a village half-way to Jestro's Castle, the Knights run into…Jestro and his monsters headed the other way with Lance's parents and all the gold they've stolen. There's a big fight, until they realize they might have the same goal and decide to deal. The BOM wants to give them back all the gold and Lance's parents. Lance says “No deal.” “We'll take the gold, you can keep my parents.” It's a weird and comical stand-off. Finally, Clay convinces Lance he has to take his parents back even if they don't always get along (and, it's the only way to get the gold back.)

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.desc: Have you ever heard that the world around is full terrible plagues and diseases? One boy called Semushka knows it for sure! Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Love N' Dancing

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Desi Beatz
programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today's Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: Surtaaj of Punjab
programme.desc: “Surtaaj of Punjab” is a vibrant Punjabi musical reality show on GTC Punjabi, celebrating the rich cultural heritage of Punjab through its aspiring singers. Hosted by Saira, Anmol Aulakh and Gurjeet Singh, the show features a diverse range of talent competing for the coveted title. Renowned music directors Gurmeet Singh and Jaidev Kumar (Music Director) along with celebrated singer Jyotika Tangri, serve as the esteemed judges, guiding contestants on a musical journey. Each episode is a celebration of talent, emotion, and the magic of Punjabi music.

programme.title: Dharma Sandehalu | Kakunuri Suryanarayana
programme.desc: Dharma Sandehalu preaches rational thinking and moral awareness by questioning traditional notions of dharma. Kakunuri Suryanarayana emphasizes that true dharma lies in justice, humanity, and ethical reasoning rather than blind faith or rigid customs. The work urges individuals to think critically, act responsibly, and align moral values with social progress and human welfare.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.1
programme.desc: Hyung Joon tries to launch a cosmetics business with the help of his wealthy friend Yoon, but Yoon refuses. Hong Sam suggests they save the company by creating a Miss Korea. Meanwhile, Hyung Joon seeks out Oh Ji Young, who was the queen bee in his high school days.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.2
programme.desc: Yoon promises to fully support ViVi Cosmetics if their Miss Korea wins, so Hyung Joon, Hong Sam, and Kang Woo search for beautiful women they know. Ji Young takes Director Ma's business card and visits Queen Beauty Salon.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.3
programme.desc: Under Director Ma's guidance, Jae Hee undergoes special training to become Miss Korea, satisfying Director Ma with her excellent skills. Oh Ji Young and Kim Hyung Joon decide to participate in the Miss Korea pageant with different motives, first preparing for the 'Mandarin Lady Pageant'. Director Ma attends the 'Mandarin Lady Pageant' as a judge, where Ji Young is scheduled to compete.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.4
programme.desc: Yoon offers Ji Young to be her 'sponsor', and Ji Young leaves in indignation and a sense of betrayal towards Hyung Joon. Teacher Jung tries to get money from Hyung Joon's mother but is flustered by her formidable demeanor. After many twists and turns, Ji Young steps onto the stage for the 'Mandarin Lady Pageant'.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.5
programme.desc: Ji Young leaves the 'Mandarin Lady Pageant' venue holding Director Ma's hand, and Teacher Jung tries to stop Director Ma. However, Director Ma firmly takes Ji Young and leaves the venue. Ji Young quits her department store job and begins training with Jae Hee and Director Ma's other candidates.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.6
programme.desc: Ji Young's family opposes her participation in 'Miss Korea'. Director Ma calmly begins to persuade the family. However, when the topic of 'breast augmentation surgery' comes up, the family and Hyung Joon strongly oppose it even more. Teacher Jung secretly takes samples of ViVi Cream to Kim Kang Shik of BaDa Cosmetics to negotiate.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer
programme.desc: Scientists and entrepreneurs are testing radical ideas like solar radiation management and ocean fertilization they are finding funding for them.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

I mariti decidono di accogliere delle ragazze squillo per avere ciò che le mogli negano loro, ma le consorti li scoprono e la moglie dell'uno finisce nelle braccia dell'altro.

Prendono in ostaggio prima una donna, Maria, poi un uomo a cui sequestrano l'automobile, non sapendo che sulla vettura si trova anche un bambino molto malato.

programme.title: Venere in pelliccia – Le malizie di Venere

Sviluppa così una relazione intensa con lei, ma senza pretendere l'esclusiva del suo corpo, anzi sottoponendosi a ripetute umiliazioni, schiavo d'amore della sua musa dominatrice.

programme.title: Peccato di castità

Dovrebbe essere più che felice, visto che sta partendo per il viaggio di nozze e che è riuscita a superare le difficoltà che si frapponevano tra lei e il matrimonio. In realtà non è così: ha fatto voto di mantenersi vergine la prima notte di nozze ed ora non sa come spiegarlo all'ignaro marito.

programme.title: Sentivano uno strano, eccitante, pericoloso puzzo di dollari

programme.title: Il mio amico Jekyll
programme.desc: Grande commedia con Ugo Tognazzi e Raimondo Vianello. Il professor Giacinto, mite direttore di un istituto per ragazze malviventi, viene ogni notte rapito da un folle soprannominato "Dottor Jekyll," che gli inietta strani sieri. Giacinto si trasforma così nel sadico Professor Fabius, compiendo atti licenziosi e violenti sulle ragazze. Il suo segreto viene infine scoperto da un poliziotto.

programme.title: Telefoni Bianchi

Tra ambizioni, compromessi e seduzioni, scopre quanto sia fragile il confine tra successo e illusione. Risi offre una satira acuta sull'ascesa sociale e sul fascino ingannevole dello spettacolo.

programme.title: Amore mio aiutami

Raffaella è quindi invaghita della nuova fiamma ma, confidando nella comprensione del marito che si vanta da sempre del suo essere moderno, aperto e razionale, chiede il suo aiuto.

programme.title: Splendori e Miserie di Madame Royale
programme.desc: Alessio, ex ballerino omosessuale, ha solo due consolazioni, la figlia adottiva e i momenti in cui si traveste con sontuosi abiti femminili e si fa chiamare Madame Royale, durante le festicciole con gli amici. Un giorno la figlia finisce nei guai e un losco commissario promette al ballerino di proscioglierla se accetterà di diventare una spia della polizia.

programme.title: La grande abbuffata
programme.desc: In una villa fuori Parigi quattro vecchi amici si riuniscono per un week-end abbandonandosi ad un`orgia di cibo e sesso. Uno di loro, Marcello, porta con sé alcune prostitute che disgustate dall`ambiente se ne andranno. Ad un certo punto una maestra va lì per caso con in suoi alunni in visita al giardino della villa, rimane affascinata dai quattro e decide di fare ritorno unendosi a loro nel folle e autodistruttivo fine settimana...

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: Il corsaro nero
programme.desc: Il capitano Black un pirata coraggioso e affascinante, alla guida della sua ciurma decide di assaltare la nave che porta l`oro dalle colonie spagnole alla madrepatria. Quando scopre che la nave non trasporta oro, ma la moglie del viceré della colonia, Black decide di rapirla per chiedere l`oro in riscatto. Anche Skull vuole l`oro, si allea così con altri pirati nemici di Black per sottrargli la donna..

programme.title: C'era una volta
programme.desc: Napoli, XVII secolo. Il principe Rodrigo Ferrantte y Davalos, nobile spagnolo di grande fascino e coraggio, è in Italia. Deve trovare una sposa e la corte gli impone la scelta tra sette belle principesse. Ma lui s`innamora di una paesana, semplice, fiera e sanguigna, di rara bellezza e di incredibili virtù, di nome Isabella. Il loro amore, fulmineo e improvviso, incontrerà molti ostacoli...

programme.title: You Cannot Kill David Arquette
programme.desc: Definito come l'uomo più odiato del wrestling, l'attore David Arquette tenta un difficile ritorno allo sport che ha bloccato la sua promettente carriera a Hollywood. Pericolosamente determinato a riscattare la sua reputazione e a recuperare il rispetto per se stesso, Arquette non si fermerà davanti a nulla per guadagnarsi un posto nel wrestling professionistico.

programme.title: And then I go

programme.title: Any Day Now
programme.desc: Los Angeles, alla fine degli anni '70. Rudy Donatello lavora come drag queen in un locale a West Hollywood. Una notte, dopo il suo spettacolo, incontra Paul Fleiger, e presto diventano una coppia. Quando Marco Deleon, un ragazzo di 14 anni affetto dalla sindrome di Down, viene abbandonato dalla madre tossicodipendente, Marianna, in seguito all'arresto di lei, Rudy e Paul decidono di prenderlo con loro. Tratto da una storia vera.

programme.title: Micheal Jackson
programme.sub-title: Chi ha ucciso il re del pop
programme.desc: 25 giugno 2009. La morte di Michael Jackson sconvolge il mondo. Chi ha ucciso il re del pop? Sembra che ognuno abbia una sua teoria, dall'omicidio premeditato al tragico suicidio. Contiene interviste e testimonianze dirette di Jermaine e Tito Jackson, Elizabeth Taylor, Diana Ross e altri. Riprese di provini, video della vita privata, la telefonata al 911 e la cerimonia funebre. Attraverso gli alti e bassi della vita di Michael, questa 'inside story' esamina i fattori e gli eventi che hanno contribuito alla sua morte

programme.title: XX secolo

programme.title: Becoming Jane
programme.sub-title: Il ritratto di una donna contro
programme.desc: Jane Austen è una ventenne romantica e indipendente nell'Inghilterra del 1795. Jane sogna un matrimonio d'amore mentre sua madre è ansiosa di accasarla con un aristocratico facoltoso. L'arrivo di Tom Lefroy, affascinante ma privo di mezzi, sconvolgerà gli equilibri della piccola comunità locale.

programme.title: La casa del diavolo
programme.desc: Sequel del sanguinoso 'La casa dei mille corpi', la psicotica famiglia Firefly vaga senza meta, lasciando sulla strada una scia di morte e distruzione. È, però, braccata da uno sceriffo feroce e due cacciatori di taglie senza scrupoli: la caccia sarà spietata.

programme.title: Halloween The Beginning
programme.desc: Il feroce assassino Michael Meyers viene rilasciato dall'istituto psichiatrico in cui è stato rinchiuso per 17 anni e si scatena alla ricerca della sorella minore. Questo significa solo una cosa: nessuno è al sicuro!

Janet si trasferisce da sola in un nuovo appartamento. La ragazza comincia ad essere vittima di allucinazioni e scopre che tra quelle quattro mura aleggia un'inquietante presenza, che la condurrà al suicidio. Lara, la sorella, decide allora di indagare sulla scomparsa della sorella...

programme.title: Una corona per due
programme.desc: La storia d'amore tra Mandla e Riley sembra andare a gonfie vele. Quando Mandla invita Riley a conoscere i suoi genitori in Sudafrica, la ragazza scopre che il suo fidanzato è in realtà un principe. Triste e arrabbiata decide di lasciarlo e tornare a casa, ma Mandla farà di tutto per riconquistarla...

programme.title: Batti Cuore
programme.desc: La conduttrice Samantha Desouza è incaricata di presentare un programma che riunisce amori perduti. Anche se l'amore è l'ultima delle cose che ha in mente, Samantha finisce per cedere all'affascinante Jake, che chiama per risolvere un suo problema. Samantha seguirà per una volta il cuore?

programme.title: Innamorarsi sul ghiaccio
programme.desc: Mary, proprietaria di una libreria di Denver, e Adam, giocatore professionista di una squadra di hockey, si rivolgono alla stessa agenzia di pubbliche relazioni per migliorare la propria immagine e lo stile di comunicazione. Ben presto si rendono conto che, come spesso accade in amore, gli opposti si attraggono.

programme.title: La Fragranza del Cuore
programme.desc: Dopo essersi allenata come profumiera a Parigi, Rosalie torna nella sua piccola città natale. Decide di aprire un negozio per vendere il suo profumo, e l'unico spazio disponibile è di proprietà del precedentemente geek, ora bello Ryan.

programme.title: Hacker mortale
programme.desc: Quando Molly incontra Jack, crede di aver trovato il nuovo amore della sua vita. Le cose diventano sinistre quando Molly decide che dovrebbero prendersi del tempo separati e Jack diventa il suo peggior incubo.

programme.title: Delitto al matrimonio
programme.desc: Una wedding planner si occupa delle imminenti nozze del fratello da cui è separata, solo per essere coinvolta in una pericolosa rete di inganni potenzialmente mortali.

programme.title: Willed to Kill
programme.desc: Una detective della omicidi è costretta a lavorare a fianco del suo ex fidanzato per indagare su un omicidio che porta tutte le caratteristiche di un famigerato serial killer.

programme.title: La casa del cuore
programme.desc: Alla vigilia del matrimonio della sorella, Lisa Bentron, un agente immobiliare, si trova a competere con l'affascinante costruttore Matthew Wallace, che vuole acquistare la storica tenuta di famiglia. Potrà Matthew conquistare la chiave di casa e del cuore di Liz?

programme.title: Love at the Ranch
programme.desc: Allison Sawyer è la reporter di punta del Metropolis Post, nota per i suoi articoli di altro profilo. La sua prossima storia è scrivere il profilo di una delle sue autrici preferite, Annabelle Lee. Annabelle basa tutti i suoi romanzi romantici sulla bellezza senza tempo del Clyborne Ranch, lontano dalla vita di città. Allison si reca al ranch e incontra Hank e la sua adorabile nonna, Stella, che gestiscono il posto insieme da anni. Man mano che Allison si avvicina alla vita di Annabelle, si avvicina molto anche ad Hank. Quando la scintilla scocca, le sorprese attendono ad ogni angolo.

programme.title: Permanent Midnight
programme.desc: La promettente carriera di uno scrittore comico è completamente deragliata dalle sue folli dipendenze da droghe che lo hanno inseguito da burattini e sparato mentre fa da babysitter alla figlia.

programme.title: Woman wanted
programme.desc: Emma viene assunta come governante da Richard, un vedovo solitario, e suo figlio Wendell, un ragazzo tormentato dal lutto. La sua presenza porta luce nella casa, ma accende anche una rivalità inaspettata: quando sia il padre che il figlio si innamorano di lei, le tensioni esplodono.

programme.title: The girl in the book
programme.desc: Alice è un'aspirante scrittrice che non ha la vita che sognava anche a causa di un trauma personale.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: L'amore sa dove trovarti

programme.title: In the Name of the King 3
programme.desc: Hazen, un mercenario americano che vive a Sofia, ha la possibilit di eseguire un ultimo grande lavoro prima di cambiare vita.L'obiettivo sono i tre figli del miliardario Andon Dupont e tutto sembra procedere per il meglio fino a quando un medaglione indossato da uno dei ragazzi lo manda nel Medioevo

programme.title: The House of the Spirits
programme.desc: Basato sul romanzo best-seller di Isabel Allende, La casa degli spiriti è un' indimenticabile storia romantica che attraversa le vicende di tre generazioni della famiglia Trueba.

programme.title: A proposito di donne
programme.desc: Dopo aver compiuto involontariamente un crimine, tre donne intraprendono un viaggio attraverso il paese che le aiuterà a riscoprire il senso di appartenenza e l'amicizia.

programme.title: L'odore della notte
programme.desc: Remo Guerra è un poliziotto dalla doppia vita. Durante la notte è a capo di un gruppo di rapinatori dell'estrema periferia di Roma che commette diverse rapine nelle case dei ricchi.

programme.title: Tutta colpa del cioccolato
programme.desc: Mentre si prepara per l'annuale Masters of Chocolate Festival, i piani di Aria vengono sconvolti quando perde il suo partner prima della competizione. Tuttavia, un uomo affascinante interviene presto per aiutare Aria a trovare l'ingrediente vincente.

programme.title: Tutta colpa di Sara
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata notificata della richiesta di divorzio, una donna convince un ufficiale giudiziario ad aiutarla a riottenere ciò che le è dovuto.

programme.title: Senza santi in paradiso
programme.desc: Bob e Ruth sono una coppia di fuorilegge che vengono catturati dopo una sparatoria. Bob si prende la colpa dell'accaduto e Ruth viene rilasciata e porta avanti una gravidanza. Dopo quattro anni Bob evade per conoscere la figlia mai vista finora.

programme.title: Vuoi cucinare con me?
programme.desc: Il comproprietario di un impero di fast-food scopre una cittadina del New Mexico dove i buongustai sbavano davanti alle prelibatezze culinarie di una bella ed esuberante cuoca.

programme.title: Frammenti di follia
programme.desc: La Dott. Dupont inizia un nuovo lavoro in un ospedale psichiatrico. All'improvviso è lei stessa una paziente.

programme.title: Maximilian

programme.desc: Il grande imperatore europeo Massimiliano e la sua storia. Al suo fianco Maria, duchessa di Borgogna.

programme.title: Maximilian
programme.sub-title: Il gioco del potere e dell'amore - Maximilian - Il gioco del potere e dell'amore S1 E2
programme.desc: Il grande imperatore europeo Massimiliano e la sua storia. Al suo fianco Maria, duchessa di Borgogna.

programme.title: Lei è la mia pazzia
programme.desc: Bruce, marinaio tormentato, salva Alison dagli squali ma finisce in un delirio omicida per amore.

programme.title: Passioni dal passato
programme.desc: Vent'anni fa Anne lasciò Tom e sposò suo fratello Kai. I tre si incontrano di nuovo in Malesia.

programme.title: Il Segreto del suo Volto
programme.desc: Giugno 1945. Ferita, con il volto sfigurato, sopravvissuta ad Auschwitz, Nelly torna a Berlino. Guarita a malapena dall'intervento chirurgico al volto, la donna cerca il marito Johnny, l'amore della sua vita. Quando casualmente Nelly ritrova Johnny, lui non la riconosce. L'intervento l'ha resa quasi irriconoscibile. Eppure notando in lei una vaga somiglianza con la moglie, le chiede di assumerne l'identità, sperando così di mettere le mani sull'eredità della famiglia di lei. Nelly accetta. Vuole capire se Johnny l'ama ancora o se l'ha tradita, come sostiene la sua amica. Nelly rivuole la sua vita.

programme.title: A Proposito di Noi
programme.desc: Sette personaggi, due storie. Si intrecciano all'interno di una scatola nera. I protagonisti si confessano in camera si odiano e si amano. Ognuno di loro è incastrato in un girotondo di emozioni ed è destinato a cadere per terra.

programme.title: Juliet, Naked
programme.desc: Annie vive una relazione abitudinaria con Duncan, fan ossessivo dell'ormai sconosciuto musicista rock Tucker Crowe. Un incontro con l'elusivo rocker che cambierà la vita di tutti i protagonisti.

programme.title: The Artist
programme.desc: Un divo del muto cade in disgrazia con l'invenzione del sonoro. Verrà salvato dall'amore di una sua fan.L'evento in bianco e nero che ha conquistato Cannes.

programme.title: Un divano a tunisi
programme.desc: Selma, giovane psicanalista, torna a Tunisi all'indomani della Primavera araba, decisa ad aprire uno studio privato si scontrerà con un ambiente sfavorevole.

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: Maledimiele
programme.desc: Maledimiele è la storia di Sara, un'adolescente di quindici anni che si ammala di anoressia. Inizialmente nessuno sembra accorgersi di niente: sia i genitori che le amiche del cuore faticano a vedere l'evolversi della malattia…

programme.title: Un neomelodico presidente
programme.desc: Il cantante neomelodico Leopoldo Giappone, in arte Mimmo Dany, si candida a presidente della regione Campania con una lista a sé, l'UVC. Il suo sogno tuttavia resta quello di partecipare al reality show L'isola dei famosi, e per questo ha a che fare con la malavita.

programme.title: Cara, insopportabile Tess
programme.desc: Tess Carlisle, ex First Lady, é considerata una specie di monumento nazionale. Come tale lei stessa si atteggia, nascondendo però dietro la facciata ufficiale un carattere bisbetico, ostinato, esigente e autoritario. Ne fanno le spese le persone che la accudiscono, in particolare Doug Chesnic, l´agente dei servizi segreti incaricato della sua sicurezza. Doug, da parte sua, addestrato a compiti ben più avventurosi, già si sente a disagio nella parte di angelo custode.

programme.title: Una ragazza sfrenata
programme.desc: Un'ereditiera insoddisfatta è il bersaglio di un insospettabile ladro d'auto che viene trascinata inavvertitamente in un complotto per sequestrarla

programme.title: Poliziotti A Domicilio
programme.desc: Chevy Chase, Jack Palance e Dianne Wiest sono i protagonisti di questa commedia su un mite contabile i cui sogni di diventare un super poliziotto diventano comicamente realtà. Alla ricerca di un pericoloso falsario, il duro poliziotto Jake Stone (Palance) convince una famiglia di periferia a prestargli la casa per un'operazione di sorveglianza a lungo termine. Ma questa 'tipica' famiglia è tutto fuorché tipica, con un padre eccessivamente goffo (Chase) la cui ossessione per i telefilm polizieschi mette a repentaglio l'intera operazione. Con il regista e la star di Fletch di nuovo insieme, COPS & ROBBERSONS offre comicità ad alta velocità, gag visive e commedia fisica per un divertimento assicurato.

programme.title: Ricki And The Flash
programme.desc: Meryl Streep come non l'avete mai vista prima: una chitarrista/cantante hard rock. In una pellicola originale ed entusiasmante, piena di performance musicali dal vivo, diretta dal premio Oscar® Jonathan Demme e sceneggiata dal premio Oscar® Diablo Cody, Meryl Streep interpreta Ricki Rendazzo, una virtuosa della chitarra che ha compiuto un'infinità di errori perseguendo il proprio sogno di sfondare nel mondo del rock. Tornata a casa, Ricki affronta la propria famiglia e ha la possibilità di redimersi e sistemare le cose.

programme.desc: Nell'Ottocento, due attori girovaghi aprono un locale equivoco, sfidano il governatore

programme.desc: Un' attrice cinematografica Cinese, in Francia per recitare in un remake di "Les Vampires", trova futili intrighi e vanitosi scontri sul set.

programme.desc: Un improbabile eroe si ritrova coinvolto in combattimenti e situazioni esilaranti tra azione e comicità. Diretto da Tonino Ricci.

programme.desc: Accusata ingiustamente di tradimento, Genoveffa viene esiliata e costretta a sopravvivere nei boschi con il figlio, affrontando fame e pericoli mentre la verità cerca di emergere.

Dopo un colpo andato storto, il capo banda Velvet Clark scappa, mascherandosi da cittadino rispettabile. Ryan lo rintraccia a Gunsight Ridge per un duello finale.

programme.desc: Senna Berger, aspirante fashion designer, incontra Adam e si rivedono al suo 47° compleanno.
